run_training_with_env: run the scalable agent training loop with a specified gym environment like MiniGrid-ObstructedMaze-2Dlh-v0
configure_exploration_coefficients: configure the forward and inverse dynamics loss coefficients for impact-driven exploration training
set_optimizer_params: set the RMSProp optimizer learning rate, momentum, alpha smoothing constant, and epsilon values
choose_training_model: choose a training model from vanilla, count, curiosity, rnd, ride, or episodic-counts variants
parse_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for the PyTorch scalable agent using the argparse parser object
